component.name: LiveTVScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.channelList = [] m.top.categories = [] m.top.selectedCategory = "" m.channelList = m.top.findNode("channelList") end sub
sub loadChannels(category as string) print "Loading channels for category: "; category ' Load channels from playlist for the given category end sub
sub onKeyDown(key as Integer) ' Handle remote navigation for channel selection if key = 13 ' OK/Enter ' Play selected channel end if end sub
